Q6097.reason: Modern statutes converting a fee tail into a fee simple absolute leave the grantor no reversion, so the later conveyance to the niece has nothing to pass.

Q5137.reason: An expert may base an opinion on x-rays and other data that experts in the field reasonably rely on, even if those materials are not in evidence.

Q5526.reason: Breaking into a guest's hotel room late in the evening with intent to commit a crime inside is burglary, while the other options lack a breaking, a dwelling, nighttime, or intent at entry.
